The Offering of an Unlined Robe

A nine-scene animated background story about Lay Nun Sajiki’s voluntary offering and Nichiren Daishonin’s heartfelt encouragement.

Sincere Offerings Are a Source of Immeasurable Benefit
Mount Minobu • 25 May 1275
Scene 1 of 9

Kamakura, May 1275

Near Yuigahama Beach lived the lay nun of Sajiki and her husband. The name “Sajiki” is believed to have come from a viewing platform built to enjoy the coastal scenery.

Characters: Lay Nun Sajiki • Sajiki’s husband
Lay Nun Sajiki • Sajiki’s husband
Scene 2 of 9

A letter from Mount Minobu

At Mount Minobu, Nichiren Daishonin, aged 54, continued to encourage his disciples through letters while living in simple conditions.

Characters: Nichiren Daishonin
Nichiren Daishonin
Scene 3 of 9

The unlined summer robe

As the hot summer approached, Lay Nun Sajiki voluntarily prepared a light, single-layered robe. No one prompted her. The offering arose from her own faith.

Characters: Lay Nun Sajiki • Sajiki’s husband
Lay Nun Sajiki • Sajiki’s husband
Scene 4 of 9

The journey to Minobu

The carefully wrapped robe travelled from Kamakura, across fields, rivers and mountain paths, toward Mount Minobu.

Characters: The messenger
The messenger
Scene 5 of 9

The offering is received

Nichiren Daishonin received the robe and praised Lay Nun Sajiki’s heartfelt resolve. For an ordinary person, offering a treasured robe represented profound devotion.

Characters: Nichiren Daishonin • The messenger
Nichiren Daishonin • The messenger
Scene 6 of 9

A spark as small as a bean

He compared her offering to a tiny spark touching one blade of grass in a vast spring field. In an instant, its light becomes immeasurable and boundless.

Characters: The Gosho metaphor
The Gosho metaphor
Scene 7 of 9

One robe, immeasurable significance

Although it was only one robe, its significance was equal to an offering to the Buddhas embodied in every character of the Lotus Sutra. The heart behind the action gave it immeasurable value.

Characters: The unlined robe
The unlined robe
Scene 8 of 9

Encouragement reaches Sajiki

The letter assured her that the benefit would extend to her parents, grandparents and even countless living beings. This encouragement strengthened her conviction.

Characters: Lay Nun Sajiki • Sajiki’s husband
Lay Nun Sajiki • Sajiki’s husband
Scene 9 of 9

Everything begins with one person

One sincere action can inspire another. Across generations, simple acts of compassion become a chain of hope. It is the heart that is important.

Characters: From one person to countless others
From one person to countless others
